title: Converge active RepoGround names and metadata without rewriting history
goal: Replace active Lenskit, rLens and RepoBrief product-identity references in Metarepo, Systemkatalog and current consumer documentation with RepoGround while preserving historical evidence, compatibility aliases and stable wire-contract field names.

approval.note: Der Nutzer hat am 2026-08-03 die Umsetzung der nächsten RepoGround-Aufgabe ausdrücklich beauftragt. Effekte bleiben auf isolierte Worktrees, exakte Heads, Diff-Prüfung, relevante Tests und PR-/CI-Gates begrenzt.

acceptance.assertion: Every active fleet, catalog, entrypoint and current consumer reference to Lenskit, rLens or RepoBrief is classified as identity, compatibility alias, stable contract field or history.
Active product and repository identity uses RepoGround consistently in Metarepo, Systemkatalog and current documentation.
Completed tasks, receipts, archived documents, historical commits and quoted prior names are not rewritten.
Stable fields such as rlens_context_ref are renamed only through an explicit versioned schema migration with compatibility tests; otherwise they remain documented aliases.
Repository validation and affected consumer tests pass on exact reviewed heads with no broken links or missing fleet/catalog entries.

metadata.source_observation: Current Metarepo and Systemkatalog active text still contains Lenskit/RepoBrief identity while RepoGround is published and Bureau active bindings now use repo.repoground.

broad_bureau_scope_migration.rationale: The implementation lives outside Bureau; Bureau is consumed only as canonical task and Registry truth.

dependency_convergence.reason: T026 is an explicitly recorded post-cutover residual and does not consume or establish the missing T025 authoritative convergence-closeout receipt.
does_not_establish: authority to alter T025 closeout evidence

metarepo.observed_legacy_surface: only explicit rejection/guard paths for deprecated Lenskit/tools identity

systemkatalog.observed_legacy_surface: archived evidence, negative tests and one dated review statement only
tests: scripts/validate_system_catalog.py: status valid after canonical provenance tags were fetched

repoground.default_worktree: clean and two commits behind; intentionally not mutated
repoground.observed_contract: docs/contracts/repoground-naming-hard-cut.v1.json declares RepoGround as the sole active identity and preserves versioned data contracts/history

readiness_evidence.nonconflict: No open PR or active Grabowski repository lease was observed for metarepo, systemkatalog or repoground.

readiness_does_not_establish: that no additional current consumer outside the declared scope contains a legacy identity
permission to rewrite history or stable versioned fields
merge or deployment authority beyond normal PR and CI gates
